newsitem.title: UK: Gartmore wins 36 mln stg Berkshire Europe mandate.
newsitem.headline: Gartmore wins 36 mln stg Berkshire Europe mandate.

text.p: Gartmore Investment Management said on Tuesday it had been appointed European equity manager for the Berkshire County Council pension fund.
The 36 million sterling active mandate was awarded to Gartmore after a contest with Bank of Ireland Asset Management, Mercury Asset Management and Pictet Asset Management.
It is part of Berkshire's full review of overseas asset management operations.
Schroders Plc was recently awarded Berkshire's 38 million sterling Japanese mandate and an announcement is expected soon on its U.S. mandate.
Fleming and Mercury maintain their UK equity mandates with Berkshire.
The objective of the European mandate is to outperform the FT/S&P Europe ex UK index.
